typography.headings: Display sans-serif, uppercase, tracking-tighter (e.g., font-black tracking-tighter uppercase). Use for section titles and massive metric numbers.
typography.metrics: Monospace, tabular-nums. CRITICAL for all changing live numbers to prevent layout shifting.
typography.labels: Tiny, uppercase, wide tracking (text-xs font-bold tracking-widest text-zinc-500) for metric overlines.

visual_enhancers.corners: CRITICAL: sharp corners everywhere. rounded-none. No exceptions. This is an OS terminal/HUD.
visual_enhancers.shadows: No glowing drop-shadows on standard cards. Flat, 2D aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using border-[#1A1A24] or border-[#2A2A35].
visual_enhancers.accents: Limit neon accents. 80% of UI must be monochrome (zinc/black). Use neon strictly for active indicators and primary actions.

layouts.density: High density, functional spacing. No wasted space.

live_monitoring.strategy: The 'Command Center' - A high-density, real-time HUD prioritizing legible telemetry and performance hierarchy over aesthetics. Inspired by racing telemetry dashboards and military OS interfaces.

states.offline: Center a stylized 'AGENT OFFLINE' block. Ghosted/dimmed stats grids with '--' values in text-zinc-800. A massive, terminal-style 'INITIALIZE TELEMETRY [LAUNCH]' button in Volt Yellow.
states.live: Full color saturation for indicators, metrics pulsating natively.

layout_structure.top_bar: col-span-full flex justify-between items-center bg-[#0F0F12] border border-[#2A2A35] p-4. Contains Live Status Pill (pulsing success green dot + 'TELEMETRY LINK: ACTIVE'), Current Game name (monospace), Session Started timer, and Launch/Stop Toggle Button.
layout_structure.metrics_grid: Grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 col-span-full. 4 Bento cards for instant readouts.
layout_structure.main_content: Grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 col-span-full. Left 2 columns for Charts, Right 1 column for secondary tools (Bottleneck, Summary, Alerts).

real_time_stats: Card 1 (Performance): FPS (Huge, White or Volt Yellow if > 144) + Render Latency (ms).
Card 2 (CPU): Util % + Temp °C. Color code temp > 85 to Warning/Danger.
components.charting_strategy:
DO NOT combine all into one chart. Use Tabs ('PERFORMANCE', 'THERMALS', 'UTILIZATION') or stack 3 separate slim charts. 
1. Performance: FPS (primary) & Render Latency. Y-Axis MUST be domain={['auto', 'auto']} to avoid clipping high FPS.
2. Thermals: CPU °C & GPU °C. Y-Axis domain={[0, 100]}.
3. Utilization: CPU % & GPU %. Y-Axis domain={[0, 100]}.
Use Recharts LineChart with dot={false}, isAnimationActive={false} (for better 1s tick performance), strokeWidth={2}.
components.bottleneck_detector: Placed top of sidebar. OS-alert style box. If CPU-bound, border turns Warning Orange; if GPU-bound, border Info Blue. Monospace diagnosis text (e.g., 'SYSTEM STATUS: GPU BOUND').
components.session_summary: Data table list, border-[#2A2A35], tabular layout. Includes Reset button (Volt Yellow outline).
components.obs_overlay: Input field with API link, 'COPY' button. Dark gray bg, text-zinc-400.
components.thermal_alerts: Form with tight mono inputs (max °C), enable checkbox, and a sharp submit button.
components.reflex_tips: Minimalist static list with subtle left-border accents for info.

instructions_to_main_agent.charting: Implement separate charts or a tabbed interface for charts to solve the clipping and overlapping issues. Disable recharts animations for 1s interval data to prevent UI jank.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Apply font-mono tabular-nums for all live updating numeric values.
instructions_to_main_agent.styles: Strict adherence to rounded-none and #09090B/#0F0F12 backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure all buttons, inputs, and tab triggers have robust data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui but customize them heavily to remove default border-radius (rounded-none). 2. NEVER use AI emojis. 3. Ensure micro-animations on interactive elements (hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors). 4. Do not center align the app container. 5. Include data-testid on every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='launch-telemetry-btn'). 6. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
